replayContract.intent: Keep T3 Code operable by voice through Theo, durable queues, Follow Mode, exact Send it authorization, and native background policy.
preserve: Preserve one-device Voice Session ownership, wake-free local Stop, and optional Barge-In.
Preserve exact Prepared Prompt revisions and mandatory Send it authorization.
Preserve durable Response, Attention, Pending Turn, Follow Timeline, and Theo Profile state.
Preserve independent STT, Theo, and TTS settings and fail closed for unsupported speech selections.
Preserve bounded, redacted, untrusted context retrieval from T3 threads, project docs/source, DNS-pinned public HTTPS pages, and registered connected-app adapters.
Preserve durable authenticated device bindings and exact Prepared Prompt recovery across reconnects.
Preserve explicit approved Theo fallbacks and per-Voice-Session remote call budgets without disabling local safety.
Preserve isolated new-agent handoff bootstrap and conservative provider checkpoint mapping.
Preserve the standalone headed Electron harness and feature-level OTG-UT-001 through OTG-UT-023 contract.
safeAutoRepair: Move thin RPC, root-mount, settings-panel, Electron-window, quick-action, or mobile-root wiring to equivalent upstream seams while interface tests remain green.
Adapt provider event names only when the new event has the same conservative approval, blocker, test, or terminal semantics.
Update Expo or Playwright configuration syntax while retaining background microphone indicators, permissions, custom renderer protocol support, and fail-closed policy.
stopForHuman: Stop if upstream removes the orchestration dispatch, snapshot, subscription, settings, or thread-projection seam or changes authorization semantics.
Stop if mobile or Electron platforms cannot truthfully provide the declared background microphone behavior.
Stop if a replay would weaken Send it, confirmation, ownership, privacy, redaction, or unknown-outcome safeguards.
Stop if provider event changes cannot be conservatively mapped without narrating unknown raw events.
